summary: Glamsterdam 在 Sepolia 激活并完成最终确定，这是 ePBS 和区块级访问列表第一次上公共测试网，nero_eth 称它会带来以太坊上线以来最大的吞吐提升。规范侧围绕账户和交易继续推进：EIP-8298（SETCODEFROM）补上公共内存池规则，EIP-7906 的 TXTRACE/TXDIFF 按 warm 读取定价，EIP-8141 把 frame 过期验证器部署为标准合约。

summary_en: Glamsterdam activated and finalized on Sepolia, the first time ePBS and block-level access lists ran on a public testnet, and nero_eth called it Ethereum's biggest throughput increase since launch. Account and transaction specs kept moving: EIP-8298 (SETCODEFROM) gained public mempool rules, EIP-7906's TXTRACE/TXDIFF views are priced at warm read cost, and EIP-8141 deploys the frame expiry verifier as a standard contract.
